jobs.description:
Headquarters:  United States, Remote
 

  ROLE:  Business Systems Administrator 
  Location:  United States, Remote 
  This is a fully remote opportunity and can be worked from any location in the United States.  
  ABOUT THE COMPANY:   
 Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we're building the industry's first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth. 
 With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won — the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate. 
 Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future. 
  THE OPPORTUNITY  
 At Salesloft, our  Business Systems Administrator, Customer Experience  is critical to our company’s success. You will be a key member of our fast-growing and high-performing Business Systems team and will lead generating, scoping, solutioning, and executing process and efficiency improvement efforts across customer-focused systems. You will have a passionate, capable team supporting you.   
 You will be responsible for the support, development, and maintenance of Salesforce and its related Customer Experience systems. You must own the pursuit of a world-class technology experience for our customers, while enabling scale and efficiency for internal customer experience teams - Support, Services, and Success. You need to have pride in the work you do and a passion for customer support and success.  
 On a day to day basis, you will:  
 
 Work with Services, Success, and Support teams to identify manual process that can be automated 
 Scope, Plan, Recommend, and Deliver system solutions that help these teams meet their Objectives and Key Results 
 Play a leading role in the exploration, design, build, delivery, and support of a redesigned and improved Customer Hub 
 
 This role lives at the heart of how we Make Your Mark: you'll treat systems administration as a discipline — automating, documenting, and fixing root causes so the same issues don't recur. And in the spirit of how we are Customer Inspired — where every decision has a true north, and it's our customer — you'll administer access and configuration as the security controls they are, protecting the company and the data customers trust us with. 
  WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR  
 We are seeking a Salesforce CRM, and related customer experience systems, expert. Someone that can see the big picture, future state but has a keen eye for details. You will have a knack for spotting opportunities to improve systems and process, and are excited to work cross-functionally to make it happen. You are passionate to build relationships to help others succeed. 
 If you’re looking for an opportunity to learn more, do more, and become more, then becoming a   Business Systems Administrator is the career path for you! 
  THE TEAM  
 Our Salesloft’s Revenue Operations team is comprised of seasoned and up-and-coming operational experts. 
 Values: Move as One, Evidence over Ego, Lead from the Front, Make Your Mark, Customer-Inspired. 
 The Revenue Operations team consists of team members that work with Sales, Marketing, Customer Services, Finance, and IT to create systems to more efficiently prospect, forecast, close, onboard, and support customers. Team members conceptualize the strategic priorities for the company, develop execution plans, execute plans cross-functionally, and operationalize executed strategies for continuous improvement.  
  THE SKILL SET  
 
 Bachelor's degree 
 3+ years experience in a related role, Software (SaaS) experience is a plus 
 2-3 years experience administering Salesforce Service Cloud, Salesforce Knowledge, Live Agent, and Customer Communities preferred 
 Salesforce Administrator certification is required 
 Salesforce Service Cloud Consultant certification is a plus 
 Demonstrated experience designing, revising and managing Salesforce Flows 
 Ability to lead teams through change management and business transformations 
 Excellent project management skills and the ability to collaborate with management and others in the company 
 Disciplined, flexible, and autonomous work habits; we don't micromanage 
 Understanding of the SaaS business model and culture is a plus 
 
 At Salesloft, we are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace where everyone belongs and can thrive. We focus on culture add, not culture fit, and believe our teams are made stronger by the unique perspectives, experiences, and identities each person brings. 
 
 We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Em

Lessons take place on the weekends during the fall and spring, and Monday-Saturday during the summer.     For the Spring 2027 semester, classes will run from late February through late June with teaching days on Friday evenings, Saturdays, and Sundays.  ·         February – June: Fri 16:30 – 20:30 (UTC+8)                                         Sat, Sun 08:30 – 20:30 (UTC+8)     Compensation  ·         360 USD per newly developed lesson – includes in-class materials as well as homework, grading keys, and supplementary materials  ·         Teaching hours are paid separately – 75 USD per 90 minute lesson  ·         Remuneration is through Wise (wise.com) between the 10th and the 12th of each month.    Technology Requirements  ·         Fast & stable internet connection (³ 20 Mbps)  ·         Modern, reliable computer (~10,000+ on www.cpubenchmark.net/cpu_list.php)    Application Process  If you are interested in applying, please send the following to us at teaching@jadeclass.com:  ·         Your resume  ·         A link to your introduction video (Vimeo, YouTube, Google, or other safe platforms). The video can be 1-2 minutes in length, telling us a bit about your education and teaching background. If you send us a video file instead of a link, please make sure it is smaller than 20MB.     ·         Where you saw our job posting   ·         The name of the position for which you wish to apply   Please understand that due to the high volume of applications, we are only able to consider applicants who submit all the information listed above. Thank you for your interest in JadeClass Education!

 About Us and Why We're Hiring 
 We're ChiroCat, and we build cloud-based chiropractic software that practices across the United States love and trust. From the first patient interactions with digital intake forms to the final insurance processing and post-visit communication, our system supports doctors and their staff every step of the way. We’re modernizing the chiropractic software space in big ways, but much more importantly, we’re bettering the lives of our doctors, their team members, and especially their patients.  
 The bottom line: we LOVE to help people who help people. And that’s where you come in!  
 We’re building something special at ChiroCat; both with our product and the people behind it. We’re not like “the other guys,” and our customers know it. They tell us, and more and more, they’re telling their peers about ChiroCat, too. But truth be told, we haven’t done a great job of showcasing what sets us apart to the rest of the world.  Be a thoughtful communicator in written and spoken forms. It’s an art you enjoy improving! 
 
 
 Love to learn. In short order, you’ll need to get fluent in the world of chiropractic, medical practices, and the people who run them. 
 
 
 PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 Experience with email marketing platforms and in-app messaging tools (we use Intercom)

 ChiroCat started with a simple mission: Empowering caregivers to transform lives through tools they trust. Our culture is built on genuine care for our customers, each other, and the meaningful work we do.

  Experience with long-context models or non-Transformer architectures  
  Open-source contributions in ML or research tooling  
  Prior startup or applied research experience  
  Why Join Us  
  Real ownership over research direction at a  Series A stage   
  Strong support for  publishing and open research   
  Tight feedback loop between research and real-world deployment  
  Access to meaningful compute and production-scale problems  
  Small, highly technical team with deep ML and systems expertise  
  Example Backgrounds  
  ML researchers from academia transitioning to industry  
  Research engineers with published work in model efficiency  
  PhD / Post-doc graduates or industry researchers who still want to publish

 Experience building human-review tooling or feedback loops that feed back into training and evaluation data. 
 
 How we work and what we offer

Who We Are:  At  Hunt St , we help Australian companies hire top remote talent in the Philippines. For this role, you will be engaged directly by the client as an independent contractor. We are not an outsourcing agency. All of our roles are 100% remote so you'll be able to work from home.   Who The Client Is:  An Australian retailer specialising in quality pet supplies, animal feed, and rural lifestyle products. They offer a wide range of products for domestic pets, livestock, and farm animals, with a focus on providing practical solutions and quality supplies to meet the needs of pet owners, animal carers, and farming communities.   Role Overview:  The Bookkeeper is responsible for managing the day-to-day financial administration of an Australian retail business, ensuring accurate transaction processing, payroll, reconciliations, and financial recordkeeping. Working primarily within the Cobalt (Merlin) POS system and Connecteam software, this role handles accounts receivable, weekly payables, payroll processing, bank reconciliations, and cash flow monitoring. Beyond routine bookkeeping, the successful candidate will help identify financial discrepancies, support stock control activities, and improve reporting and business processes.  Key Responsibilities:   
 Manage day-to-day bookkeeping and financial transactions using the Cobalt (Merlin) POS system. 
 Process accounts receivable entries across approximately 2,000 store products, ensuring accurate transaction records. 
 Prepare and process weekly accounts payable, including supplier invoices and payment records. 
 Process payroll using Connecteam software, ensuring employee hours and payment details are accurately recorded. 
 Perform bank reconciliations and investigate discrepancies between bank statements and internal financial records. 
 Monitor cash flow and conduct till checks to verify that daily takings match expected banking amounts. 
 Maintain accurate financial records and prepare regular bookkeeping and management reports. 
 Assist with stock control, inventory monitoring, purchasing, and product cost analysis using spreadsheets. 
 Identify opportunities to improve financial processes, reporting accuracy, and overall business efficiency. 
  Requirements  Required Skills and Qualifications:  
 2+ years of experience as a Bookkeeper or in a similar accounting or finance administration role. 
 Solid understanding of accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll processing, and bank reconciliations. 
 Experience with POS or retail management systems; Cobalt (Merlin) experience is highly desirable. 
 Familiarity with payroll software, particularly Connecteam, or similar platforms. 
 Experience handling high-volume transactions and maintaining accurate financial records. 
 Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, including working with formulas and financial data. 
 Strong written and verbal English communication skills, including the ability to understand Australian regional accents. 
 High attention to detail, sound organisational skills, and the ability to manage recurring deadlines independently. 
 Experience with management reporting, financial analysis, retail inventory, stock control, or product costing is an advantage. 
  Work Arrangement & Expectations:  This is a remote role that will be set up as an independent contractor engagement.  To ensure alignment and transparency, successful candidates will be expected to:  
 Disclose any existing ongoing roles or client work 
 Reflect this engagement on their LinkedIn profile (clearly marked as “Independent Contractor”)

Rules of engagement, deal registration & attribution  Own the rules that govern how partner deals are registered, protected, sourced, and credited, including sourced vs. influenced credit, lookback windows, and the line between partner credit and partner marketing credit. Lean, high-output team  Build a small team of AI-native operators, and work across Sales, Marketing, Finance, Legal, and Customer Success to drive change as the ecosystem scales.     3+ years experience operating a multi-type, multi-region partner ecosystem  - GSIs, regional SIs, resellers, distributors, ISVs, and hyperscalers.

Job Description Summary    As Academics Leader for international markets, you will shape and lead  GE HealthCare ’s academic strategy outside the United States, Canada and China. Academic medical centers and research institutions adopt advanced technology early, publish, shape guidelines and train the next generation of clinicians. When we win with academics, we influence the whole market.  You will build and personally own the commercial account strategy and executive relationships for approximately 20 strategic academic accounts, develop the International Academics commercial framework and orchestrate execution with country and zone teams. You will partner closely with Scientific Affairs under clearly defined Research-Commercial rules of engagement.   This role owns the commercial strategy, customer experience, pipeline and business results for the International Academics segment.  Focus markets include the United Kingdom, France, Germany, Spain, Japan, South Korea, Australia and India, as well as the international accounts among  GE HealthCare ’s top 50 global academic accounts.  At  GE HealthCare , our machines, our software, our solutions, our services, and our people make a genuine difference to medical professionals and patients all over the world. That’s because we never lose sight of what healthcare really needs—the human touch.  Job Description    Your role:     Commercial academic relationships and account strategy    
 Build and maintain trusted, senior relationships with leading academic medical centers, research institutions, universities and scientific societies in the focus markets.  
 Personally own a portfolio of about 20 strategic academic collaborations, from identification and structuring through governance, delivery and renewal.  
 Develop flagship, multi-year and cross-modality commercial partnerships and enterprise solutions, including differentiated customer experience and co-location models where appropriate.  
 Use proven models from the United States and Canada and scale them to international accounts.  
 Establish reference and showcase sites that demonstrate  GE HealthCare  solutions, customer outcomes and innovation adoption, with any research claims or scientific outputs led and approved through Scientific Affairs and the appropriate functions.  
   International Academics commercial framework    
 Develop and own the international academic commercial framework: one engagement model, standard work for academic account management, rules of engagement, key performance indicators (KPIs) and governance, including executive and C-suite governance for strategic accounts.  
 Segment academic accounts, including research-active private accounts, and define targeted value propositions and growth plans for each segment.  
 Lead with differentiated entry points, such as care pathways, theranostics, photon-counting CT, nuclear medicine, AI and areas such as human performance and longevity.  
 Continuously improve the framework based on results, customer feedback and learnings from the United States and Canada. 
   Country orchestration    
 Work hand in hand with country and zone leadership teams to embed academics in every focus country plan and in plans for the top 50 global academic accounts.  
 Orchestrate the framework across countries, aligning country commercial teams, segment and care pathway leaders, product teams and services behind shared academic priorities.  
 Coordinate a virtual network of country academic account leads, clinical specialists and regional academic leaders, with clear roles and accountability. 
 Share best practices and results across markets, and escalate and resolve barriers to collaboration quickly. Scientific Affairs partnership  
 Partner closely with Scientific Affairs while maintaining clear separation of commercial and research activities and following the agreed Research-Commercial rules of engagement.  
 Align commercial stakeholder mapping and engagement plans with the Scientific Affairs-led KOL framework.  
 Support adoption of new product introductions at academic accounts through coordinated commercial launch planning, customer readiness and white-glove application and service support  
 Translate existing, approved evidence and scientific outputs into compliant commercial value propositions and customer communications in partnership with Scientific Affairs, Marketing, Legal, Regulatory and Compliance.  
 Identify customer needs or opportunities related to research, grants, evidence generation, publications, symposia or scientific meetings and refer them to Scientific Affairs for assessment, ownership and execution.  
   Commercial performance    
 Own orders, revenue and margin targets for the international academic segment, and grow  GE HealthCare ’s share of wallet in target academic accounts.  
 Build and manage the international academic commercial pipeline, and run a disciplined cadence of account plans, opportunity reviews and forecasts.

   Commission:  £250–£350 per closed account (tier-dependent) with uncapped earnings. Top partners earn £4,000–£8,000+ per month.

  Weeks 1–4: Generate at least 3 free trial signups per week → receive £500 guaranteed that week  
  Week 5 onward: Generate at least 4 free trial signups per week → receive £500 guaranteed that week  
  In any week where your commissions from closed accounts exceed £500, you earn the full commission instead  
  The draw is ongoing — not just for your first month. Hit your numbers, get paid. Every week.  
  This means you’re never working for nothing while your pipeline builds. Trials convert to paying customers, commissions grow, and the draw becomes your floor — not your ceiling.  What You’ll Be Doing  You’ll be visiting local businesses — salons, restaurants, gyms, coffee shops, pet groomers, dental practices — and showing them how  can handle their marketing while they focus on running their business.   A typical approach might look like this:

  Walk in and start a conversation — "Hi, I work with . Who handles your social media?"  
  Show a quick demo on your phone  
  Offer a 14-day free trial — no risk for them  
  Follow up — when they convert, you earn your commission

  Self-starters who don’t need someone managing their diary

The Career Path  Omada Sales Territory Partners aren’t capped. Top performers progress through a clear leadership pathway with increasing commission rates, territory ownership, and team-building opportunities:  
   Territory Partner  — You’re in the field, closing deals, building your reputation.

   State Director  — Leading a regional team with override commissions on your team’s closes.

We want a technically strong, highly organized leader who takes pride in reliable reporting and gets real satisfaction from improving how work gets done.  Your first move will be to get close to the work: learn our operations, see what works, and find the gaps yourself. Then you will put that understanding to work by standardizing processes, strengthening controls, introducing practical AI and automation, and coaching teammates to run the function with confidence.  The measure of success is simple: a stronger team and better systems that keep performing without the Controller having to do everything personally.    This is a remote role based in Latin America, working U.S. Eastern Standard Time.    Why This Opportunity Is Different  This is a chance to shape the accounting function, not just maintain someone else’s playbook. You will work directly with executive leadership, and your decisions will have a visible impact.  You will not be starting from scratch. You will lead an existing Accounting team and partner with FP&A, Business Intelligence, and Information Systems when the work calls for analysis, data, or technical integration. This is a hands-on leadership role at the start: you will set priorities, define requirements, learn the details, and successfully implement changes. The aim is to build a team and processes that deliver consistently without constant intervention.  Key Responsibilities   Accounting & Financial Reporting  
 Own the accuracy and integrity of the General Ledger, financial statements, and monthly close.

 Investigate complex accounting issues, identify root causes, and implement lasting solutions.

 Establish disciplined accounting practices, clear responsibilities, and reliable reporting that supports business decisions. 
  Leadership, Coaching & Team Development  
 Coach and mentor the accounting team to expand their technical capabilities, accounting judgment, and confidence in independently solving problems.

 Build a collaborative, organized, and self-sufficient team that consistently delivers results. 
 Create repeatable coaching rhythms, skills assessments, and cross-training so knowledge is shared and the team has stronger coverage and succession depth. 
  AI, Automation, SOPs & Continuous Improvement  
 Learn existing processes firsthand, identify what works, and prioritize meaningful improvements. 
 Build and maintain an AI-enabled accounting SOP library covering all critical accounting processes, with clear ownership, controls, version history, and documentation that supports the annual financial statement review and broader attestation requirements. 
 Lead automation of manual, high-effort accounting workflows, including marketplace cash application, revenue-share accruals and reconciliations, and accounts payable.

 Prioritize improvements by financial risk, hours saved, error reduction, and ease of adoption; test changes, train users, and ensure improvements continue working after rollout. 
 Measure success through time savings, fewer errors, improved productivity, and reduced reliance on manual processes.

 We are worker owned creative collective, innovating on everything from brands and IRL communities to IoT devices and cross platform apps. We share profit, open source everything, spin out new businesses, and invest in exciting ideas through financial and/or in-kind contributions. 
 Our client roster includes Google, Stripe, Figma, Hinge, Black Socialists in America, ACLU, Pratt, Parsons, Mozilla, The Nobel Prize, MIT, Gnosis, Etsy & Gagosian.

  Sanctuary Computer - Development  
 At   Sanctuary Computer   we’re building a different type of technology shop – one that prioritizes close collaboration between the client and the craftsperson. 
 Our projects range from design-forward websites, to robust web apps, to native mobile development. 
  XXIX - Design  
 When we started   XXIX   in 2013, we set out to create a different kind of design studio and we’ve thrived because we continually ask what a creative practice can be. 
 We’re building a radically different kind of organization that values autonomy, growth, transparency, and shared responsibility. 
  Index - Community  
   Index   is network of physical spaces all around the world, Index provides space for the exchange of knowledge and tools. 
 We nurture trust within the creative community through generosity and abundance of ideas and care. 
   garden3d TK  — Media  
 At garden3d, we’re in the early stages of building an experimental media company exploring emerging themes related to the evolving landscape of technology, design and culture. 
 We aim to monetize this outlet, publish books, produce screenplays, and release music. 
 Plus, our partner organizations 
   Lightphone     Mill     IngredientAI   
 ⛰️ The Head of Technology Role 
 The garden3d Head of Technology has one mandate: everything we build works, holds up in production, and gets built the smartest way available to us. We are a house of brands - Sanctuary Computer (development), XXIX (design), Index Space (community), USB Club (digital community), and the garden3d umbrella itself - and a lot of what all of them ship runs on software we wrote. Working in close partnership with our founder & president Hugh Francis, this person sets the engineering standard, and builds the culture that holds it. 
 You can be based anywhere. A lot of our people are in New York and there's some gravity here, but we already work across timezones and we would happily hire in Europe, Singapore, Chicago, or wherever you are. If you're the right person, we want to hear from you. 
 This role works with studio leads, developers, designers, project managers and clients across every garden3d vertical. 
 This person can move between a Rails migration, a Next.js app, a firmware release plan and an agent loop in the same week, and raise the bar on each of them. 
 They span all of garden3d, but their home base is Sanctuary Computer, where roughly 70% of their time goes. Our development studio is where the engineering standard gets set, and where it either holds or slips: architecture, code review, estimation, and the hardest technical calls on our biggest projects. The other 30% goes to garden3d's broader technology story: how we ship product for USB Club, build with agents across the collective, which tools and platforms we bet on, and what we build for ourselves.

The ideal candidate looks at a worker-owned collective with four studios, an open P&L and clients like Google, Stripe, Brooklyn Museum and The Nobel Prize, and sees an engineering practice they can propel among the best in the world.

This person has engineered complex systems for a long time, and it shows in the architecture they draw before a line is written. They own the technical blueprint on our most important projects, and they make the hard calls on the rest: what to build, what to buy, and what to leave out.
